title: Trunk-based development
description: Practice trunk-based development using a checkable offline policy or disposable Git repository, a failing starter, and an independently verified repair.
objectives: Explain trunk-based development as an engineering policy, not a magic Git behavior
Reproduce the insufficient starter policy with concrete counterexamples
Apply the rule to representative team inputs and document real hosting limitations
rubric: I reproduce the trunk-based development policy failure.
I can explain which policy is enforced locally versus by a Git host.
I demonstrate a passing repaired implementation and one negative edge case.
